Anchor wildfire AOI. manavgat_aoi resolves to manavgat_aoi_refined_bbox; the alternative manavgat_aoi_wide_buffer is a debug-only fallback that no experiment uses. Its elevation range [0.38, 2355.30] m contains all three other AOIs. Requires decision A-10b.

Largest AOI by area -- more than five times Bejis. 38.9 percent of valid cells are permanent water (Bodrum and Marmaris peninsulas); the burnable population sits in separated clusters, so the bbox centre may fall in the sea between them. Centre-to-centre distance systematically overstates separation for an AOI this wide, which is why the minimum boundary distance is reported as a secondary metric.

Listed only so it cannot be confused with evia_2021_extended. This is a SEPARATE registered experiment with its own outputs and is NOT one of the four AOIs in this analysis. Validator check 17 must assert that evia_2021_extended resolved to (23.05, 38.55, 23.85, 39.15) and not to this bbox.

Not an AOI. The fixed reference window supplying ref_mean and ref_sd for the climate standardisation, so the scale does not come from the four AOIs and does not change when a fifth is added. All four AOIs lie strictly inside it.
